career_ladder.note: UPTET is the statutory qualifying benchmark mandated by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) and Government of Uttar Pradesh for appointment as primary and upper-primary teachers in state government schools (Parishadiya Vidyalayas). Qualified candidates are directly eligible to apply for the newly announced 15,012 Assistant Teacher and Lecturer recruitment vacancies under UPESSC (Sep–Oct 2026 cycle).

exam_scheme.note: UPTET consists of two objective OMR-based papers of 150 questions (150 marks, 150 minutes) each: Paper 1 for Primary Stage (Classes 1 to 5) and Paper 2 for Upper Primary Stage (Classes 6 to 8). There is no negative marking. Qualifying threshold is 60% (90/150) for General and 55% (82/150) for reserved categories.

financial_package.note: UPTET is an eligibility certification examination and does not directly recruit personnel. Upon subsequent recruitment as Assistant Teacher in Parishadiya Primary Schools through Super TET/ATRE, candidates enter Pay Level 6 (Grade Pay ₹4,200) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 6 (Basic Shiksha Parishad Teacher Cadre)
financial_package.estimate_note: Reflects the statutory financial package upon subsequent appointment as Assistant Teacher. Calculated on Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹35,400 with 58% DA (₹20,532), rural/semi-urban HRA (₹1,500 to ₹4,000), net of 10% NPS deduction (₹5,593) and GIS.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per UP finance department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) based on rural/semi-urban school classification
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% state government matching contribution
Medical treatment reimbursement under UP state employee medical rules
Lifetime validity of UPTET qualifying certificate (per NCTE & UP Government gazette notification)
Teacher training allowances and educational leave entitlements

competition_benchmarks.note: Statistics compiled from official press releases and result declarations of the Examination Regulatory Authority (PNP Prayagraj) for UPTET cycles. As a teacher eligibility test, there are no fixed vacancies; the benchmark measures candidates qualified against total registered applicants.
